body:
Known issues: these open `P1` and `P2` issues are not on the cut list (cut line 2026-11-25T19:17Z). Their fixes ship in the next minor. `RELEASE_NOTES.md` lists them too.

Important: #4031 (a left-hand tool runs M3) and #4004 (dovetail `corner_r` is ignored; PR #4009 was removed from the cut).

- #4085 (P1): DIN/ISO Heidenhain post writes no stop or M6 at a tool change on a manual-change machine (Picomax)
- #4055 (P2): Path kernel: the camcraft-pathkernel crate skeleton, the stage types and the one switch
- #4038 (P2): Path kernel phase 1: Thread plans through the path kernel on side/path-kernel
- #4037 (P2): Path kernel phase 1: Slot Undercut plans through the path kernel on side/path-kernel
- #4036 (P2): Path kernel phase 1: Trochoidal slot plans through the path kernel on side/path-kernel
- #4035 (P2): Path kernel phase 1: Slot plans through the path kernel on side/path-kernel
- #4034 (P2): Path kernel phase 1: V-Carve plans through the path kernel on side/path-kernel
- #4031 (P1): Tools: a cutter hand on the tool, so a left-hand drill or mill is refused or turned M4, not run M3
- #4027 (P2): Path kernel K7: one test suite that checks each strategy against the kernel laws
- #4026 (P2): Path kernel K3: one load control stage for trochoidal and constant engagement passes
- #4025 (P2): Path kernel K1: one region model for selection, material side and bounds
- #4023 (P2): Path kernel: one motion planning pipeline for all strategies
- #4004 (P1): Dovetail cutters: read the corner radius (`corner_r` is accepted but ignored, so the flank is too thin)
- #3934 (P1): Pass starts at Outside: every strategy clears in straight lines, not along the stock and the selected edge
- #3933 (P2): 2D Pocket offset rings: waterline-like passes with a nominal engagement, not a constant-engagement spiral
- #3849 (P1): 2D Adaptive Trochoidal: the clean-up passes are not checked against the engagement limit
- #3788 (P1): 2D Offset one ring set: full-width cuts where the rings of two lobes merge (fig8 waist), and the narrow note does not name them
- #3759 (P2): Face and the 2D Adaptive Outside plan: air entries through the shared entry rule, Adaptive lifts with a named reason (identical output)
- #3758 (P2): Trace, Engrave and 2D Chamfer: loop changes on the shared ring linker, with a named reason for each lift (identical output)
- #3757 (P2): 2D Contour: level links and wall entries on the shared ring linker and entry rule (identical output)
- #3756 (P1): Bore: rings on the shared circle ring set, as arcs by the chord tolerance, linked at depth with no lift between rings
- #3755 (P1): Circular: cut the rings of a level in one walk at depth; no lift and no new entry into material at each ring
- #3754 (P2): Do not touch, the 2D Adaptive ring fallback and the 3D Pocket levels on the shared ring set (identical output)
- #3753 (P2): 2D Pocket rest machining and the Zigzag closing rings on the shared ring set: one chain law (identical output)
- #3752 (P1): 2D Pocket: Waterline, OffsetRings, Inside and Outside on the shared ring set; rings link in the plane and lift only with a named reason
- #3750 (P1): 2D ring planning step 1: one shared ring set, ring linker and entry rule, taken from the 2D Offset path (identical output)
- #3746 (P1): 2D Offset Pass starts at Inside and Outside: enter in air outside the stock box, then an arc lead-in in the cut plane with Arc radius and Arc sweep
- #3334 (P2): Start and exit points: Plasma Profile and the future waterjet kinds (pierce point and cancel point)
- #3331 (P2): Start and exit points: turning kinds (start in the Z-X plane)
- #3330 (P2): Start and exit points: multi-axis kinds (5-axis, swarf, rotary, flow, multi-axis rough and contour)
- #3329 (P2): Start and exit points: 3D kinds (3D Pocket, 3D Finish, Deburr)
- #3327 (P2): Start and exit points: 2D Adaptive (entry of the first pass, end of the last pass)
- #3325 (P2): Start and exit points: 2D ring and chain kinds (Pocket, Offset, Circular, Slot, Trochoidal slot, Trace, Engrave, Chamfer)
- #2629 (P2): GPU stock sim S3: viewport playback cuts on the GPU, with CPU fallback
- #2424 (P2): Windows 11, desktop Ryzen 5 with onboard Radeon: the whole PC freezes with screen "snow" while CamCraft v0.23.0 runs
- #1473 (P2): Start and exit points: exit points, viewport pick, and the cases the first contour slice refuses
- #1448 (P2): Operations: user-set start and exit points, path regenerated to them
